    • validateStructure

      public void validateStructure() throws ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      Checks that every transition has at least one input place it actually consumes from.

      The check deliberately does not live in PetriT.createInP(ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.ArcIn[]), which runs while a net is still being assembled: an editor adds places, transitions and arcs one at a time, so an incomplete net has to be allowed to exist and is validated only once it is whole.

      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - naming the first transition with no consuming input at all
